_about: Public-domain Daniel Wilson (1778-1858, evangelical Vicar of Islington, then Bishop of Calcutta and Metropolitan of India) for the Word Hoard: The Evidences of Christianity (2 vols, Boston 1829-30), Sermons and Tracts (2 vols, London 1825), The Divine Authority of the Lord's Day (third edition, 1840), Expository Lectures on Colossians (1846) and Sermons Delivered in India (catalogued 1838), raw Internet Archive OCR. Not Sir Daniel Wilson the archaeologist, nor his son Daniel Wilson (vicar of Islington from 1832): the Islington items here are dated before 1832. Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 14 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

dwilson-evidences-1: The Evidences of Christianity, stated in a popular and practical manner, vol. 1 (Boston: Crocker and Brewster, 1829)
dwilson-evidences-2: The Evidences of Christianity, stated in a popular and practical manner, vol. 2 (Boston: Crocker and Brewster, 1830)
dwilson-sermons-tracts-1: Sermons and Tracts, in two volumes, vol. 1 (London: George Wilson, 1825)
dwilson-sermons-tracts-2: Sermons and Tracts, in two volumes, vol. 2 (London: George Wilson, 1825)
dwilson-lords-day-1840: The Divine Authority and Perpetual Obligation of the Lord's Day, third edition (London: J. Hatchard and Son, 1840)
dwilson-colossians-1846: Expository Lectures on St. Paul's Epistle to the Colossians (London: J. Hatchard and Son, 1846)
